I’m Kapil Dev Pal, a software engineer in New Delhi focused on SaaS products, APIs and business workflow automation, with client work across media production, healthcare staffing, logistics, marketplaces and education.

I deliver features end to end — from requirements and technical design to tested code, deployment and production support — across backend and full-stack development, event-driven background processing, microservices, secure authentication and access control, database performance tuning and CI/CD.
